context:
BLURSPOT
Designed an AI-driven civic issue reporting platform to streamline problem resolution like potholes
and leakages. Citizens can submit reports with images, which are auto-classified and pinned to a
live map. Features include real-time updates, status tracking, heatmaps for high density zones,
instant department alerts and strong user privacy controls.
Tech stack: React.js,Google Maps API,Node.js,MongoDB(Atlas),Bcrypt.js,TensorFlow.js
CALL FRAUD DETETCTOR 
Developed a call fraud detection system that analyzes caller ID, call type, frequency, duration, cost,
and location patterns. Utilized rule-based logic and anomaly detection to flag suspicious behavior
like spoofing, premium-rate abuse, and unusual call volumes. Included a database for logging,
blacklist checks, and real- time fraud alerts. 
Tech stack: Python, Mongo DB, FastAPI, Flask, AWS, Flutter
RESTAURANT RESERVATION SYSTEM 
Designed and implemented a comprehensive restaurant reservation system using the MERN stack.
This system allows users to search for restaurants, create secure reservations by logging in and out,
and ensures enhanced security by providing email verification.
Tech stack: Node JS, React JS, Mongo DB, Express JS, Tailwind CSS
